currentRoundInspection.scope: Connected Palazzo Vecchio exterior: mapped palace ranges and four open courts, rusticated buff masonry, paired arched window rhythm, projecting machicolated gallery/crenellations, red ceramic roofs, actual recessed front portal/threshold/treads and the Torre di Arnolfo. Tower has a clock surface proxy with static hands, projecting corbelled terrace, actual open arched belfry, crown crenels and original schematic gold weather-vane. No copied heraldry/inscriptions/sculpture, furnished rooms, flags or adjacent Loggia/Uffizi models.
